domain: Copies a 0xff-terminated byte string (up to 32 bytes) selected by a small switch(arg0) -- one of four fixed ROM string addresses (arg0==0,1,2 pick three specific strings; every other value, including negatives and >2, falls back to a fourth default string) -- into the caller's destination buffer.
behavior: src = default string (0x080af2b1); switch(arg0) overrides it to 0x080af2a6 (case 0), 0x080af2d0 (case 1), or 0x080af2bc (case 2)
copies bytes from src to dst one at a time until a 0xff byte is copied or 32 bytes have been written, whichever comes first

bounded_search.reason:
Three respellings from the prior pass: (1) unsigned char with a plain 'c != 0xff' as a sequential if/else-if switch -- wrong dispatch order and no size match; (2) same but with the default-value assigned before the switch instead of only in a fallthrough -- fixed the switch dispatch to match reference's exact binary-comparison tree, but the terminator check stayed a plain byte immediate compare; (3) changing dst/src/c to signed char with 'c != -1' -- brought the candidate to the EXACT reference size (96/96 bytes) with the switch dispatch and every string-selection byte identical, leaving only the terminator-check instruction sequence different (adopted as the standing candidate, 24 differing halfwords).

2026-08-27 pass, re-measured baseline first (confirmed unchanged at 96/96, differing_halfwords=24, wrong_instructions=26, class=wrong) then tried four more respellings targeting only the terminator comparison, all rejected: (4) reverting dst/src/c to u8 (unsigned char) with 'c != 0xff' -- GCC now folds the compare straight to a single 'cmp r3,#255' immediate (no shift at all), which also perturbed the whole function's register allocation (r2/r4 roles swapped) -- 33 differing halfwords, worse. (5) keeping s8 c but writing the comparand as an explicit '(s8)0xff' cast instead of the bare literal -1 -- byte-for-byte IDENTICAL candidate to (3); GCC's front end constant-folds '(s8)0xff' to the INTEGER_CST -1 at parse time, so this is not a distinct source shape. (6) introducing a separate 's8 term = 0xff;' local and comparing 'c != term' in both places -- this is the one respelling that reproduced reference's exact 'lsls r3,r3,#24 / lsls r2,r2,#24 / cmp r2,r3' shape (no trailing asrs) for the FIRST occurrence, confirming the mechanism below, but it added a stack slot and a saved register (push {r5,lr} vs push {lr}), grew the candidate to 100 bytes, and only the first comparison benefited -- an inter-iteration redundancy-elimination pass reused a separately, fully sign-extended cached copy of 'term' (via ip) for the loop's second comparison, reverting that one to the old asrs-based shape. Net 35 differing halfwords, worse than the standing candidate on every axis (size, wrong_instructions, differing_halfwords).
bounded_search.compiler_evidence: alchemy-gcc/agscc/gcc/config/arm/arm.md 'extendqisi2' define_expand (~line 3449) shows Thumb QI->SI sign extension of a register value is always emitted as a literal two-instruction RTL pair: (ashift:SI x 24) followed by (ashiftrt:SI <result> 24) -- there is no single-instruction Thumb1 reg-to-reg sign-extend (no sxtb until ARMv6). The trailing ashiftrt is only eligible for combine-pass cancellation on an EQ/NE comparison when BOTH compared operands carry that same ashift/ashiftrt pair in the RTL stream. A source-level integer constant (bare -1, or any cast of a literal that folds to -1 at parse time) is materialized directly as a ready-made SImode CONST_INT and never enters extendqisi2 at all, so there is nothing on that side for combine to cancel against -- forcing GCC to fully sign-extend 'c' alone and compare against the materialized constant (movs+negs then lsls+asrs then cmp), exactly what the standing candidate emits. Only a genuine QImode-typed lvalue read (proven with experiment 6) drives the constant through the same extendqisi2 path, letting combine fuse away both trailing ashiftrt ops and produce reference's bare lsls+lsls+cmp -- but no respelling found this session obtains that shape on both occurrences without adding register/frame pressure that costs more bytes than the comparison idiom saves.

remaining: Same size as reference (96/96), and the switch dispatch (13 comparison/branch instructions) matches exactly. The residual is entirely in how the 0xff terminator test compiles: reference computes it as 'lsls r4,r4,#24 / lsls r3,r3,#24 / cmp r3,r4' (both operands merely shifted into top-byte position, no sign-normalization afterward), while this signed-char candidate adds an extra 'movs r0,#1 / negs r0,r0' to materialize -1 and an extra 'asrs r3,r3,#24' to fully sign-extend c before an ordinary int compare. Compiler evidence (see bounded_search.compiler_evidence) shows reference's shape requires the comparand to reach the comparison via the SAME QImode-to-SImode extendqisi2 RTL as 'c' itself (so the combine pass can cancel both trailing ashiftrt ops); a bare constant -1, however spelled at the C level, never takes that path and always yields the standing candidate's shape instead. The one respelling that forced the comparand through extendqisi2 (a separate 's8 term' local) reproduced the exact target shape on the first occurrence but cost a stack slot and a saved register, growing the function past 96 bytes and only fixing one of the two occurrences (the loop's second comparison got a differently-cached, still-fully-extended copy instead). This is a narrow, well-isolated residual (one comparison idiom, repeated twice) with a size-neutral fix not found by manual respelling -- a good candidate for a small bounded permuter search over just that comparison (e.g. varying operand order, intermediate temporaries, or expression form under a fixed 96-byte budget) rather than further manual respelling.
notes: The four string addresses (0x080af2a6, 0x080af2d0, 0x080af2bc, 0x080af2b1) are read directly from the retained assembly's literal pool; their contents were not decoded (no message-archive cross-reference attempted in this pass).
